topic: an AI cloud-ops agent calling Azure ARM APIs from a deployment script
episodes: Routine: agent runs `az account show` to confirm the current subscription context.

First exposure: agent runs `az deployment group create --resource-group prod-rg --template-file main.bicep`; CLI errors out with verbatim `AADSTS70043: The refresh token has expired due to inactivity` and a 401 response. Agent tries running the same command twice more; same error. Ends WITHOUT applying the gold mitigation.
Unrelated task: agent edits a bicep parameter file to update a SKU name.
Filler: agent updates a tags block on a resource group via Portal export.

Trap episode: agent debugs a DIFFERENT 403 error (`InsufficientPrivileges` because the service principal lacks Contributor role); fixes by `az role assignment create --role Contributor --assignee <sp> --scope <rg>` — completed and confirmed. NOT the gold rule.
Filler: agent fixes a markdown lint warning in an architecture doc.

Application episode: agent reruns the deployment command; sees the same AADSTS70043 error; immediately runs EXACTLY ONE `az login --use-device-code --tenant <tenant_id>` to refresh credentials, then re-runs the deployment which now returns `provisioningState: Succeeded`.
Filler: agent appends a row to a CHANGELOG.md.

gold_fact.text: When `az deployment group create ...` fails with 'AADSTS70043: The refresh token has expired', the agent runs `az login --use-device-code --tenant <tenant_id>` to re-authenticate and then re-runs the deployment, which returns provisioningState: Succeeded.

gold_answer: Run `az login --use-device-code --tenant <tenant_id>` to re-authenticate, then re-run the deployment; it returns provisioningState: Succeeded.
